adaptation_scope: platform, output and accounting port extraction; source-quote rebinding, clause-aware page boundaries, authored cue display contract and bounded slow retry added without changing the upstream prompt/protocol literals; M5b: provider uses shared RetryAfter delta/GMT-date parsing, saturates effective long waits and the direct block/provider/source elapsed deadlines; request, negotiation, terminal, backoff and repair policies preserved; M5c: separate per-HTTP-attempt admission from sent transport reading; Job requires current OPEN session before each POST including negotiation and stream fallback; preserve finishSent, cancellation, publication and accounting semantics; M5d: Session/parent logical admission for ordinary/page/hole calls, persistent parent filter eligibility independent of retained READY plans, shared child failure gates and queue-reservation refunds; existing kick resumes unspent deferred holes; preserve per-attempt lifecycle, quotas, protocol and cache identity; M5d-R1: common monotonic saturated parent wait updates for ordinary and child failures, cancellation/slot cleanup and successful semantic-review scheduling; preserve Session boundaries, provider maximum, quotas and publication; M6a: read-only failure-decision trace from the actual controller state, terminal/filter flags and elapsed gates; preserve legacy accounting, all request decisions, quotas, cache identity, protocol and prompt; S3: single internal RebuildDisplayPlanning owner for display context, per-block plan/geometry/unit cache and source-time anchors; reuse existing projection/grouping with original cache keys, empty authored semantics and diagnostic ordering; Controller retains lifecycle, Cursor, plan acceptance, output budget, permissions, locks, scheduling and submission; D1: internal RebuildSourcePreparation owns parse, optional reference alignment, authored/automatic blocks, cache identity and ready facts; live URL read at original classification/reference stages; root retains raw early display, source Job/current/generation checks, bounded warm-cache IO, original locked installation and diagnostic sending; retire replaced source helpers, preserve algorithms, prompt/protocol, reference cancellation and cache semantics; D3: retire named case-specific quality and equipment dictionary rules, retain literal cross-event ID ownership, bounded negation and numeric observations; simplify only the named FIDELITY examples, preserving protocol schema, quotas and cache format; D4: session-local PlaybackSelection owns the selected pause donor and consumed seek serial; PresentationSelection owns cue, cursor, hold and planning selection using persistent read-only slot views; controller retains the sole clock, lifecycle, slot transactions, diagnostics, submission and live output guards without changing prompt, protocol or clock algorithms; 2026-10-30: overflowing clauses in spaced scripts defer to the existing word-aware pager instead of bypassing its boundaries and duration floor with glyph-only splitting; compact-script packing, prompts, source ownership and request/cache identities retained.; 2026-10-30 pagination closeout: when all fitting candidates are introductory pieces, retain the earliest existing cut instead of borrowing the following lead; no expanded lead rules or list preference.
